test_policy.notes: International undergraduate page: SAT or ACT scores, essays and recommendation letters are not required; only transcripts and proof of English are needed. Domestic first-year applicants with a 2.75 GPA do not need scores; automatic admission is also possible with a 23 ACT / 1130 SAT or top 10% of class. Common Data Set: scores 'not required, but considered if submitted'.

requirements.notes: SIU's own online application, $40 non-refundable fee. International freshmen need a 2.75 GPA (4.0 scale) from high school, translated official transcripts (scans accepted for admission, originals needed on arrival) and proof of English. A specific major must be chosen (no 'Undecided' for international applicants). After admission, ISS requests a passport copy, financial statement and affidavit of support for the I-20; an older CIE page cited a $40,000 minimum financial statement. Some programs have extra requirements.

deadlines.label: Preferred application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Dec. 1 is the university-wide preferred/priority date (apply page; catalog: 'preferred application deadline shall be December 1, for the following fall semester'). The international admissions page itself prints no separate deadline.

deadlines.label: Applications after this date reviewed case-by-case (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Apply page: applications received after May 1 are reviewed case-by-case. No year is printed, so fall 2027 is assumed. Admission is rolling and no international-specific date is published.

deadlines.label: Campus-based scholarship deadline (most scholarships)
deadlines.notes: Apply page: 'February 1 is the deadline for most campus-based scholarships' (the page gives no year, so 2027 is assumed). The page is written for FAFSA filers; it does not say whether international students may apply.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived with two face-to-face English composition courses at a U.S. college (grade A or B), more than 48 U.S. college credit hours, citizenship of an English-primary country (exempt list), the final two years at a U.S. high school, or domestic-style test scores of ACT 23+ / SAT 1140+. Official SAT and TOEFL reports must come directly from the testing agency. Conditional admission: applicants who meet academic standards but not the English score can start in SIU's Center for English as a Second Language (CESL); passing the required CESL levels gives a Certificate of Completion that satisfies the English requirement. Also accepted: TOEFL paper 520 and ITEP Academic Plus 3.6 (ITEP is not in the tests listed here).

english.notes: No minimum on the new 1-6 scale is published.

aid.notes: High Achievers Alternate Tuition Rate: international freshmen with a 3.5 GPA, or ACT 26, or SAT 1240 pay in-state tuition (about $9,833 vs $24,581 per year in the Common Data Set). The older tuition page lists SAT 1170 instead of 1240; the figures here follow the current international page. Transfers need a 3.0 GPA and 26 credits. The Common Data Set says institutional need-based and non-need-based aid exists for nonresidents (44 degree-seeking undergraduate nonresidents got aid, average $19,488), but the admissions pages do not describe international need-based aid, so it is not yet confirmed.

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the SIU admissions pages; look it up in the College Board search.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the SIU admissions pages.

toefl.note: No TOEFL code is printed; scores must be sent directly by ETS.
